categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文主要集中在 Agent 群体与科研自动化、模型内部可解释性与训练算力效率，以及基准测试与可复现性等研究基础设施建设。

articles.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
articles.zh: SwarmEvolve：用于进化式发现与优化的潜空间 Agent 群体
articles.summary: 如果你在琢磨多 Agent 怎么才能真正“涌现”出发现能力，这篇把进化搜索搬到潜空间做群体协同，路子值得一看
articles.author: Qile Jiang, George Em Karniadakis
articles.body: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLM）引导的进化式搜索，会利用 AI 智能体（AI agents）来改进解决数学和计算问题的程序：一轮轮打磨解法，再把高分方法拼起来。但这个过程往往很慢，因为 LLM 每一轮都要生成一大段文字版思维链，而且为了保持种群多样性，还得反复生成很多次。我们提出了 SwarmEvolve：每轮都有几百个低成本智能体成群结队地干活，直接在潜空间（latent space）里推理，不用把想法解码成文字，靠传 KV 缓存（KV caches）来共享信息。每个智能体集群从不同角度研究问题。新颖性过滤器（novelty filter）直接量智能体隐藏状态向量（hidden state vectors）之间的距离，把最有区分度的想法留下来。想法的交叉（crossover）在潜空间里自然发生：总结器智能体（summarizer agent）会收到整个集群所有成员合并后的 KV 缓存。在数学发现和科学计算领域的 21 个问题上，SwarmEvolve 拿到最高的平均分，而且只需中位数 3 到 8 分钟，就能达到其他最先进（state-of-the-art）框架 60 分钟才达到的最好成绩。在好几个问题上，配上 Qwen3 8B 的 SwarmEvolve 还改进了 AlphaEvolve 最初用前沿大模型（frontier LLMs）找到的解。我们的工作说明，能在潜空间里交流的智能体集群，为科学问题里的程序搜索提供了一种又快又便宜的路子。

articles.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
articles.zh: Scientist World：为 AI-Scientist 培育一个可生长的研究世界
articles.summary: 如果你想让 AI 自己跑通科研流程，而不是只写综述，这篇提供的是一个可演化的交互研究环境，重点在“世界”而不是“模型”
articles.author: Taiming Lu, Sachin Konan 等
articles.body: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.
articles.bodyZh: AI-Scientists（AI科学家）已经登场了，但一个能让它们成长的世界还没出现。人类科学家早就把属于自己的那个世界当成了理所当然——几百年来留下的开放问题、共享的想法，都摆在科学文献里等着。对AI-Scientists来说，这个世界能读，却不能跑，所以我们给它们造了一个Scientist World（科学家世界）：每篇研究论文都变成一个可执行环境（executable environment）。我们的自动化流水线会提取每篇论文里的开放式研究问题，并把论文提出的方法复现成基线（baseline）；一个AI-Scientist进入这个环境后，就拿它的表现和人类作者当初做出来的成果比。我们首批发布了1000个经过验证的环境。把这个“世界”当成评测场，我们发现前沿AI-Scientists（frontier AI-Scientists）已经有74%的时候能超过人类研究者。作为AI怎么做科学的记录，它包含6400小时的研究轨迹（research traces），每一个想法、实验、失败和成功都在里面。作为训练场，我们能把一个小模型提升158%，让它在研究构思（research ideation）上追平前沿模型。终于，AI-Scientists自己的世界来了——它从科学本身长出来，也会跟着科学一起长。

articles.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
articles.zh: XStack：面向 ML 仓库迁移的基准测试
articles.summary: 如果你指望 AI Agent 帮你迁移 ML 代码库，这个 benchmark 会告诉你它在真实仓库上到底会在哪里失败
articles.author: Linrong Cai, Taiming Lu 等
articles.body: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%. XStack is a step toward freeing ML code from its ecosystem. We release XStack to make progress toward reliable migration across frameworks and hardware measurable.
articles.bodyZh: 机器学习（ML）代码，应该在研究者想让它跑的地方运行，而不是它最早被写出来的地方。现在机器学习代码主要活在两个生态里：NVIDIA GPU 上的 PyTorch，和 Google TPU（张量处理单元）上的 JAX。要把代码仓库（repository）从一个生态搬到另一个，就得跨框架、跨硬件去构建和测试。这种迁移，一来是现实需求，因为能让研究者用上不同的硬件；二来也是个天然的基准测试（benchmark）：它涉及不同框架和硬件，覆盖整个仓库，而且周期长、难度高。我们推出 XStack，一个评估智能体（agent）把机器学习仓库在这两个生态之间迁移的基准。每个智能体拿到一个 PyTorch 仓库和一台干净的 TPU 机器，必须交付一个 JAX 仓库。它的输出要满足我们的评分标准才算通过；这个标准基于源仓库公开的结果，并由我们做认证和校准。现在让智能体来做迁移还不太靠谱：Claude Opus 5 通过率 75%，GPT-5.6-sol 45%，其他智能体最多 40%。XStack 是朝着让机器学习代码摆脱生态束缚迈出的一步。我们发布 XStack，是希望让跨框架、跨硬件的可靠迁移变得可衡量，并能持续取得进展。

articles.title: Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information
articles.zh: 行为相同，机制不同：有限实验能为整合信息（Integrated Information）证明什么
articles.summary: 如果你被“某模型具备意识”之类的说法误导过，这篇从数学上说明有限实验根本无法验证其机制，行为一致不等于内部一致
articles.author: Linqian Wu, Diaoxuan He
articles.body: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs. Experiments see that law only through finite, partial and noisy interventions. We ask when such a quantity is identifiable from an experiment's access, continuous in the mechanism and certifiable from finite data, and answer exactly for a deliberately demanding case - the integrated information $\varphi$ of integrated information theory - in stochastic networks of four and five units with known ground truth. Behavior can be silent: a recurrent and a feed-forward network with identical input-output laws at their response delay carry 0.28 and 0 bits, yet internal recordings separate them within 4-53 trials. Partial access can be just as blind: in our examples, units left out of a one-step recording impose precision floors of 0.30-1.02 bits that no sample size lowers, and in all-but-self parity networks, recordings of any length see several hidden units only through the product of their fidelities - a symmetry that one intervention broke in exact checks. The measure has sharp edges: because $\varphi$ selects a partition, and the cause and effect it specifies, by one criterion and reports another, infinitesimal changes of mechanism that cross an edge change it by 25-100% at 99% of the edges we found in random networks, and about 1% of surrogate models that fit interventional data almost perfectly misreport it by more than 20%. One-sided claims survive: the same data certify a lower bound on both sides of an edge, and we prove $\varphi>1.004$ bits throughout a 64-dimensional region of mechanisms and certify it from about $10^7$ controlled transitions with false-certificate probability at most $α$. Measurability is thus a design question with computable answers.
articles.bodyZh: 可解释性（interpretability）、AI 审计（AI auditing）和机器意识评估，越来越依赖机制层面的量：也就是系统因果转移律（causal transition law）的泛函（functional），它描述系统“怎么算”，而不是“输出什么”。实验只能通过有限、不完整、带噪声的干预（interventions）来看到这条规律。我们要问：这种量在实验能接触到的范围内，什么时候可识别（identifiable）、对机制变化连续（continuous）、还能用有限数据认证（certifiable）；然后对一个故意挑得很苛刻的案例——整合信息论（integrated information theory）里的整合信息量 φ——在四个和五个单元、真实答案已知的随机网络（stochastic networks）里，给出精确回答。行为上可能完全“看不出声”：一个循环网络（recurrent network）和一个前馈网络（feed-forward network），在响应延迟处的输入-输出规律一模一样，承载的 φ 分别是 0.28 比特和 0 比特，可只要做内部记录（internal recordings），4 到 53 次试验（trials）就能把它们分开。只接触部分单元也可能一样“瞎”：在我们的例子里，一步记录（one-step recording）漏掉的单元会带来 0.30–1.02 比特的精度下限（precision floor），样本量再大也压不下去；而在“除自己以外全是奇偶校验”的网络（all-but-self parity networks）里，不管记录多长，几个隐藏单元（hidden units）都只能通过它们保真度的乘积（product of their fidelities）被看到——这种对称性在精确检验里被一次干预打破了。这个指标有很锋利的边（sharp edges）：因为 φ 用一个标准来选分区（partition）、选它指定的因和果，却用另一个标准来报告，所以机制只要发生无穷小的变化、跨过一条边，数值就会跳 25%–100%；在随机网络里我们找到的边中，99% 都这样；而且大约 1% 的替代模型（surrogate models）几乎完美拟合了干预数据，却会把 φ 报错超过 20%。单边结论还站得住：同一批数据能在一条边的两边都认证一个下界（lower bound）；我们证明，在一个 64 维的机制区域里 φ>1.004 比特，并用大约 10^7 次受控转移（controlled transitions）把它认证出来，误认证概率（false-certificate probability）最多为 α。所以，可测量性（measurability）其实是一个设计问题，而且答案可以算出来。

articles.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
articles.zh: 通过扩展激活反演来解读任意残差流方向
articles.summary: 如果你想直接读取 LLM 残差流里任意方向的语义，这套可扩展的激活反演值得一试，前提是你能熟练使用可解释性工具链
articles.author: Celeste De Schamphelaere, Juan J. Vazquez 等
articles.body: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out SAE features. It also identifies concepts behind steering vectors about as well as NLAs, recovers the payloads of LoRA backdoors more often than corpus search, and can even verbalise some model workspace inner monologue. Unlike explanations produced by other metamodels (e.g. NLAs), MAEM exemplars can be verified with a forward pass on the subject model, making the MAEM objective a grounded alternative for scaling the training of metamodels.
articles.bodyZh: 要解读语言模型残差流（residual stream）里的某个方向，我们可以去找能强烈激活它的文本。但如果是靠扫描语料库来找，找到的文本就只能限于语料库里有的东西。我们开发了最大激活示例元模型（Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels，MAEMs）：这是一类语言模型，能把某个主体模型（subject model）的残差流方向映射到能强烈激活这些方向的文本示例上。我们的目标是，让 MAEM 生成的文本激活值，和给定残差流方向之间的余弦相似度（cosine similarity）尽量大。这个不依赖标签的强化学习（label-free RL）目标，有助于让 MAEM 在多种来源的残差流方向上扩展训练。实验上，我们发现训练出来的元模型能生成很有信息量的示例：一个基于 Qwen3.6-27B 的 MAEM，在反演留出激活上比语料库搜索或自然语言自编码器（NLA）都更好；在大多数留出的语言/领域上，它胜过用 1000 万 token 做语料库搜索；还能激活 89% 的留出稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征。它识别引导向量（steering vectors）背后概念的能力，和 NLA 差不多；找回 LoRA 后门（LoRA backdoors）载荷的频率，比语料库搜索更高；甚至还能把模型工作区里的一些“内心独白”说出来。和其他元模型（比如 NLA）给出的解释不一样，MAEM 生成的示例可以在主体模型上跑一次前向传播（forward pass）来验证，所以 MAEM 的目标函数为扩大元模型训练规模提供了一个更扎实、可验证的替代方案。

articles.title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
articles.zh: 拆解强到弱 OPD 相比 GRPO 的算力效率
articles.summary: 如果你在纠结蒸馏和小模型 RL 训练哪个更省算力，这篇把 OPD 和 GRPO 的算力消耗逐项拆开算给你看
articles.author: Zeyu Leo Liu, Yang Li 等
articles.body: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under a frozen teacher's per-token supervision. Does this dense signal reduce the training FLOPs needed to reach a target accuracy compared with reinforcement learning? We systematically compare vanilla reverse-KL OPD with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across task difficulty, student and teacher size, domain, and optimization choices, measuring held-out accuracy against training FLOPs. With an external post-trained teacher, OPD generally loses to GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP at matched settings, even when the teacher is further trained with GRPO, and often suffers response-length inflation. Yet a different teacher changes the picture: when the teacher is the student's own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint's accuracy on math with $50\times$ fewer distillation FLOPs than GRPO needs to reach the same accuracy. Following the same teacher setting, we consistently observe this high efficiency with a larger student, on code, and in a second model family. On a single domain, however, the GRPO checkpoint is already the desired model, so distilling it adds to total compute. Across domains, separate GRPO checkpoints hold different capabilities, and no single checkpoint serves every domain. Multi-teacher OPD (DeepSeek-AI, 2026) consolidates per-domain GRPO experts into a single student that matches each expert's accuracy, with the distillation stage costing only 5.2% (on 2 domains) and 8.0% (on 4 domains) of the specialist training FLOPs. Counting specialist training and distillation together, this pipeline reaches joint GRPO's performance on the 2-domain mix with 42.0% fewer total FLOPs.
articles.bodyZh: 在线策略蒸馏（On-policy distillation，OPD）是让学生模型拿自己跑出来的结果，在冻结教师模型逐 token 的监督下训练。那这种密集信号，跟强化学习比，能不能用更少的训练算力（FLOPs）达到同样的目标准确率呢？咱们系统比较了普通反向 KL（reverse-KL）的 OPD 和组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization，GRPO），覆盖任务难度、学生和教师规模、领域和优化选择，用留出准确率（held-out accuracy）对训练 FLOPs 来衡量。用外部后训练教师（external post-trained teacher）时，在同等设置下，OPD 每单位训练算力换来的准确率通常不如 GRPO，哪怕教师再用 GRPO 继续训练也一样，而且还经常出现回答长度膨胀（response-length inflation）。但换个教师，局面就不一样了：如果教师就是学生自己之前的 GRPO 检查点（checkpoint），OPD 在数学任务上能追平这个检查点的准确率，而蒸馏 FLOPs 只有 GRPO 达到同样准确率所需的大约五十分之一。沿用同样的教师设置，我们在更大的学生模型、代码任务和第二个模型家族上也稳定看到这种高效率。不过，单领域里，这个 GRPO 检查点本身已经是想要的模型，所以再蒸馏它，反而会增加总计算量。跨领域时，不同的 GRPO 检查点各有所长，没有一个检查点能包打所有领域。多教师 OPD（Multi-teacher OPD，DeepSeek-AI，2026）把各领域的 GRPO 专家整合进一个学生模型，准确率能分别对上每个专家，而蒸馏阶段只花专家训练 FLOPs 的 5.2%（2 个领域）和 8.0%（4 个领域）。把专家训练和蒸馏一起算，这套流程在 2 领域混合任务上达到联合 GRPO 的性能，总 FLOPs 还少 42.0%。

articles.title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
articles.zh: ReproBridge：把可复现性构建到机器学习研究产出中
articles.summary: 如果你写过那种连自己都跑不起来的实验代码，这篇给出的是把复现流程嵌入研究产物的工程化思路
articles.author: Yubo Wang, Rui Meng 等
articles.body: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. Agents attempt tasks in fresh sessions with raw code or refined artifacts; a separate Auditor checks execution evidence. Across four evaluated models, refined artifacts raise mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average. The cross-model success-rate spread narrows from 21.6 to 3.9 percentage points, with all four models achieving mean success rates above 90%. Removing any component reduces success in the ablation study, with the largest losses from code and environment removal. These results suggest that preserving execution knowledge helps even models with lower raw-code success reproduce experiments more reliably and at lower API cost.
articles.bodyZh: 复现机器学习实验（machine learning experiments）时，得从散落在论文、开源代码和配套材料（artifacts）里的信息中，把整个流程重新拼出来。对编码智能体（coding agents）来说，复现能不能成功，往往取决于它们能不能把缺失的细节补上，而不只是看发布出来的产物够不够。我们想知道，如果把恢复出来的流程和决策保留下来，能不能让后续的独立复现做得更好。为此，我们定义了一套标准化产物设计（standardized artifact design），包括精炼代码库（refined codebase）、环境配置（environment setup）、实验启动器（experiment launchers）和复现指南（reproduction guide），并推出 ReproBridge——一个用来构建这些精炼可复现产物（refined reproducible artifacts）的智能体工作流（agent workflow）。ReproBridge-Bench 则提供了 1,029 个任务，来自 36 篇论文中的 387 个实验，每个任务都用五个人工核验过的参考分数做基准。智能体在全新会话里，分别用原始代码或精炼产物去尝试任务；另有一个独立的审计器（Auditor）检查执行证据。在四个被评估的模型上，精炼产物把平均复现成功率（reproduction success）从 76.4% 提高到 92.6%，还把下游 API 花费（downstream API spending）平均降低了 19.7%。跨模型成功率差距从 21.6 个百分点缩小到 3.9 个百分点，四个模型的平均成功率都超过了 90%。消融实验（ablation study）发现，去掉任何一个组件都会拉低成功率，其中去掉代码和环境造成的损失最大。这些结果表明，把执行知识（execution knowledge）保留下来，能帮助那些原始代码成功率本来不高的模型，也更可靠、更低 API 成本地复现实验。

articles.title: Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words, Not on Abbreviations or Codes
articles.zh: 类型化决策编码器中的标签措辞增强：对陌生词有增益，对缩写与代码无增益
articles.summary: 如果你打算靠改写标签措辞来提升分类效果，这篇提醒你这招只对陌生单词有效，碰上缩写和代码就不管用了
articles.author: Vladimir Beskorovainyi
articles.body: Typed-decision models score options that the caller supplies at request time, so their accuracy depends on label wording that the model's developer does not control. We compare two releases of a 307M-parameter multilingual cross-encoder, Ru-Jev, trained on thirteen Russian-language tasks; the later release adds an augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms. Holding questions fixed and varying only how eighteen routing labels are worded, we evaluate ten label vocabularies, produced by three separate processes and checked for overlap with the training data, with five candidates per question and, for eight of them, also with eighteen. On held-out vocabularies made of ordinary or borrowed words (English-derived jargon, office slang, department names), the augmented release is more accurate in every setting, by up to 0.24. Eleven of these fourteen gains survive a Holm correction (slang with eighteen candidates and descriptive sentences with five do not), and for jargon on all labels the label-level interval excludes zero in both settings. On abbreviations and opaque codes it gives no usable gain: on abbreviations it is not better, and worse on the clean slice, and on opaque codes both releases stay at or below chance once labels related to training options are removed. In most cells where accuracy rises, the risk-coverage area falls, but with eighteen candidates confident errors rise on jargon and slang. On two datasets neither release saw, accuracy moves by -8.4 and +5.6 points. We also report four evaluation hazards from comparing the two releases.
articles.bodyZh: 类型化决策模型（typed-decision models）干的事，是给调用方在请求时提供的那些选项打分，所以它的准不准，取决于标签怎么措辞——而这事儿模型开发者根本管不了。我们比较了一个307M参数的多语言交叉编码器（cross-encoder）Ru-Jev的两个版本，它是在十三个俄语任务上训练的；后一个版本加了一种数据增强，会把标签用好几种表面形式呈现出来。我们把问题固定住，只改十八个路由标签（routing labels）的措辞，评估了十套标签词表（label vocabularies）——这些词表由三个独立流程生成，还检查过跟训练数据有没有重叠；每道题给五个候选，其中八套词表还额外用十八个候选测了一遍。在由普通词或外来词（英语衍生行话、办公室俚语、部门名称）组成的留出词表（held-out vocabularies）上，增强版在每个设置下都更准，最多高出0.24。这十四项提升里有十一项扛住了Holm校正（Holm correction）——十八个候选的俚语、五个候选的描述性句子没扛住；而在行话上、所有标签都算时，标签层面的区间（label-level interval）在两种设置下都不包含零。到了缩写和不透明代码（opaque codes）上，它就没带来什么能用得上的提升了：缩写上没更好，在干净切片（clean slice）上还更差；不透明代码上，一旦把跟训练选项相关的标签去掉，两个版本都停在随机水平或以下。在大多数准确率上升的格子里，风险-覆盖率面积（risk-coverage area）会下降，但用十八个候选时，行话和俚语上的高置信错误（confident errors）反而多了。在两个两个版本都没见过的数据集上，准确率分别动了 -8.4 和 +5.6 个百分点。我们还报告了比较这两个版本时踩到的四个评估隐患（evaluation hazards）。
